crafts.name: CD Wall Decor
instructions: Clean the old CD and make sure it is dry
Paint or decorate the CD with your chosen design
Glue beads, stickers, glitter or other decorations onto the CD
Let the paint and glue dry completely
Tie a piece of ribbion or string through the CD's center hole
Hang your decorated CD on a wall as a colourful piece of wall decor
crafts.sustainability_note: The old CD is repurposed into a decorative item, giving it a new use instead of being thrown away
